answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity accrues a proof-of-attention stream; crossings between identities require a minimum attention delta verified against prior sessions. Cloned identities must each independently sustain the same observation cadence, since any pigment of shared timing collapses the pair. Enforcement: rewards unlock only after continuous, non-transferred sessions measured in the ledger. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the sustained human-hours, spreading thin across a tundra of idle accounts whose unattended gaps zero their balance.
